title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Temperature in °C can be converted to °F using this formula: °F = (°C x 9/5) + 32. Write a function which converts °C to °F, convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit.
hints: The formula multiplies the Celsius value by 9/5 first.
Then it adds 32 to that result to get Fahrenheit.
expected_behavior: Returns the Fahrenheit equivalent of a Celsius temperature using (celsius * 9/5) + 32.
explanation: The conversion formula scales the Celsius value by 9/5 and shifts it by 32 to land on the Fahrenheit scale.
